UI_GamepadTweaks_event_help_press: Runs on press unless another event on this input needs time to resolve.
UI_GamepadTweaks_event_help_double: Time from the first press to the second press. Release the input between presses.
UI_GamepadTweaks_event_help_hold: Runs once when the input has been held long enough.
UI_GamepadTweaks_event_help_modifier: Hold the modifier before pressing this input.
UI_GamepadTweaks_event_help_native: Keeps the original timing for this action.
UI_GamepadTweaks_action_useTool: Use Tool on the Square Ahead (chop, dig, water...)
UI_GamepadTweaks_tab_help_world: Vanilla controls and shared mod actions for on foot and in a vehicle.
UI_GamepadTweaks_tab_help_onfoot: Mod actions while on foot. Empty buttons fall back to General.
UI_GamepadTweaks_tab_help_vehicle: Mod actions while driving or riding. Empty buttons fall back to General.
UI_GamepadTweaks_tab_help_aiming: Mod actions while aiming or looking out of a vehicle.
UI_GamepadTweaks_tab_help_ui: Mod actions when a game panel has controller focus.
UI_GamepadTweaks_tab_help_inventory: Mod actions when inventory or loot has controller focus. Empty buttons fall back to Panels.
UI_GamepadTweaks_tab_help_cruise: Mod actions while driving with the Cruise Control button held.
UI_GamepadTweaks_steam_configDescription: Sticks and buttons work as a gamepad. Mod actions (horn, lights, drop items...) can be bound to any button, back paddle or combination.
UI_GamepadTweaks_Options_desc: Gamepad features of the mod. Turn one off to get the vanilla behaviour back. Bug fixes always work. Changes apply at once. More settings: Zomboid/GamepadTweaks.properties; button actions: Options -> Controller.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_steering_enabled_to: Off: vanilla steering, everything below in this section is off.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_steering_rawStick_t: The raw stick position steers, fine corrections work. Off: the game's stick value with its dead zone.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_steering_recenter_t: A released stick rests slightly off zero and the car drives in an arc. The mod learns where the stick rests after a release and steers from there.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_steering_scaleToSpe: Full stick = max angle at current speed
Vanilla limits the wheel angle at speed, so the outer part of the stick travel does nothing and small deflections are too sharp.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_steering_highSpeedE: Steering curve at speed (2 = soft center)
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_steering_highSpeedK: Speed for the curve at speed, km/h
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_steering_constantRa: The wheels turn towards the stick at a constant rate. Vanilla lags more with speed (up to 3 s) and returns quickly only from inside the dead zone.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_throttle_analog: Analog gas and brake on the triggers
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_throttle_analog_too: Vanilla: on/off at 0.7 of the trigger travel. Here every pedal position has its own cruising speed (light press = slow roll), easing off brakes with the engine, full pedal = vanilla. Gears stay vanilla; the tachometer and engine sound show RPM that matches the speed. Off while Tsuki's AnalogThrottle is active.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_throttle_pedalCurve: Gas curve (less = more push at the start of the travel)
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_throttle_stickCurve: Gas curve on a stick (easy driving, Steam "Steer + pedals")
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_throttle_dragExpone: Drag growth with speed (2 = like air)
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_throttle_brakeHold: Brake stops the car, reverse on the next press (experimental)
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_throttle_brakeHold_: Vanilla: LT held after the car stops starts reversing. Here LT that braked holds the car at the stop; release it and press again to reverse. Gas while backing up stays vanilla. Works with vanilla on/off pedals too.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_easyDriving_player1: Splitscreen, for players new to driving: the left stick points where to go on the screen (as walking), the wheel turns the car there; the triggers stay the gas and the brake. Players are numbered in the order they joined. A server can forbid it (sandbox option).
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_easyDriving_player2: Splitscreen, for players new to driving: the left stick points where to go on the screen (as walking), the wheel turns the car there; the triggers stay the gas and the brake. Players are numbered in the order they joined. A server can forbid it (sandbox option).
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_easyDriving_player3: Splitscreen, for players new to driving: the left stick points where to go on the screen (as walking), the wheel turns the car there; the triggers stay the gas and the brake. Players are numbered in the order they joined. A server can forbid it (sandbox option).
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_easyDriving_player4: Splitscreen, for players new to driving: the left stick points where to go on the screen (as walking), the wheel turns the car there; the triggers stay the gas and the brake. Players are numbered in the order they joined. A server can forbid it (sandbox option).
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_easyDriving_stickPe: Easy driving: the stick is the gas too
With easy driving the stick deflection is also the gas, pointing behind the car reverses: no triggers needed, but slow driving is harder to dose. Off: the stick only steers.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_triggers_noDeadZone: Vanilla applies the stick dead zone to the triggers too, so the first part of the travel does nothing (throttle, brake, map zoom).
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_actions_crouchOnPre: Vanilla toggles crouch on release, and not at all when held longer. Not used with the left stick radial menu.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_actions_sprintOnPre: Vanilla toggles sprint on release, and not at all when held longer.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_actions_vehicleOnly: Enter vehicles only with the A prompt
Vanilla also enters or exits any nearby vehicle on an Interact click, even when the button did something else.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_interact_notBehind_: Vanilla opens a window or door behind the character, even with a sofa in front. Behind, A only closes an open door: when nothing is in front, or first for 3 seconds after walking through it.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_interact_facing: Interact picks the side the character faces
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_interact_facing_too: Facing diagonally, vanilla prefers a door or window on one side over furniture on the side the character faces more.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_interact_cursor_too: A on a cursor (furniture, chopping, building) or on a light switch next to a door: vanilla also sits on the sofa or opens the door with the same press.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_interact_lootFacing: Loot window selects the container in front
Vanilla selects the first container around the character (usually the one up-left on the screen), not the one it faces.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_aim_snapFix: Aiming without the stick doesn't turn the character
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_aim_snapFix_tooltip: Without the aim stick (half RT or Steam Aim), vanilla slowly turns the character towards the top of the screen while aiming.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_map_smooth_tooltip: The pan speed follows the stick, the zoom speed follows the triggers. Vanilla moves in steps.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_map_panSpeed: Pan speed, map heights per second
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_steamInput_enabled: Mod actions in the Steam controller configurator
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_steamInput_enabled_: Bind mod actions to back paddles, long presses and chords in Steam. Needs a game restart.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_rumble_enabled_tool: Through Steam Input: needs the option above and the game started from Steam.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_rumble_triggers_too: Xbox One / Series pads: a short accent in the triggers on knocks at the front (front wheels, impacts ahead). The surface texture stays in the grips.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_rumble_test_tooltip: Each motor alone, in turn: left grip, right grip, left trigger, right trigger.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_rumble_player1_tool: Splitscreen: turn vibration off for this player only. Players are numbered in the order they joined.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_rumble_player2_tool: Splitscreen: turn vibration off for this player only. Players are numbered in the order they joined.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_rumble_player3_tool: Splitscreen: turn vibration off for this player only. Players are numbered in the order they joined.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_rumble_player4_tool: Splitscreen: turn vibration off for this player only. Players are numbered in the order they joined.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_rumble_aiming: Ambient vibration while aiming a gun
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_rumble_aiming_toolt: Heartbeat, thunder, zombies banging, glass and tools are scaled by this while aiming a firearm: the shaking moves a gyro reticle. Wounds, falls and shots stay full.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_rumble_vehicle: Vehicle crashes, running over, cones, bushes
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_rumble_suspension: Suspension: bumps, curbs, parking stops, bodies under wheels
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_rumble_thump: Zombies banging: first knocks, on the vehicle
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_rumble_ready: Press A to start: double knock
